reason: No existing skill covers the MCP connect message budget or the 2,048-character cut; the lesson recurs whenever startup text or the index grows. Created at project level as the class of connect-text changes, with the measurement evidence as a reference.

The connect text can be full with every module on, so the index is dropped; the skill names must still reach the agent, and the tool description is the uncut place for them. This was built and tested in the episode and the rule belongs with the budget rule.

The earlier measurement (startup 1911, no index) was taken with a different state; the episode measured ~2041 with first-run showing, so the note needs the current figure and the reason the names move to the tool description.

The skill's advice to put skill names in the metaform_skills description, on the claim that hosts never cut descriptions, is superseded: the server now cuts listed descriptions by rule, so the trailing Discoverable sentence would be dropped from the listing.
